title: Perplexity API key: one-property twin (length) (project-policy) [legacy tier T2]
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 47-character body vs the tool-corroborated 48 (gitleaks/osv-scalibr exact 48; flare-redact accepts 40-60, a recorded peer difference, not a provider exclusion) and length: 49-character body vs the tool-corroborated 48 (flare-redact's 40-60 range still accepts it; recorded peer difference). Twin of "Perplexity API key: must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
